Biktarvy is restricted to NDC labeler 61958 (the Gilead-coded NDC) under Code I; within that condition no PA is printed, so preferredRestriction is null. Only the single-tablet regimens named in the class description are considered. Cabenuva benefit route is not printed. Sig is standard label dosing, not printed. p.5 PEP statement applies to HIV drugs for post-exposure prophylaxis, not to this treatment class. [Sonnet check 2026-10-27: preferredRestriction was null; added the printed LR. Pick is the labeler-61958 Biktarvy product.]

records.verificationNote: Emtricitabine-tenofovir DF 200-300 mg tablet read at PDF p.19: Tier 1, carries the PREV flag (USPSTF A/B preventive drug; no cost share in select plans, p.8). Descovy 200-25 mg and 120-15 mg read at p.19: Tier 2, no flags. Apretude (cabotegravir LA) and Yeztugo (lenacapavir) do not appear in this document; Apretude is typically clinic-administered, so it may sit under the medical benefit. Not all-inclusive, so not called excluded. Document says: "Kaiser Foundation Health Plan does not have a requirement for PA" (PDF p.6) and "does not have a requirement for Step Therapy" (PDF p.7). Drugs not listed are nonformulary; when a Kaiser or referral doctor determines one is medically appropriate and necessary it is covered by formulary exception (PDF p.7; decision within 72 hours, 24 urgent, PDF p.8). Completeness is ambiguous: p.6 defines the formulary as "the complete list of prescription drugs preferred for use and eligible for coverage" but p.2 says "not an all-inclusive list", so absence is not treated as exclusion. [Sonnet check 2026-10-27: Descovy 200-25 mg carries PREV (note said no flag); Apretude and Yeztugo are clinic-administered, likely medical benefit, not called nonformulary]
